title: Quantifying the NTN Opportunity Gap: processing pipeline and derived railway deficiency maps
description:
Processing pipeline and derived railway deficiency maps accompanying the paper Quantifying the NTN Opportunity Gap: A Cross-Generation Railway Measurement Study (IEEE CCNC 2027).

The pipeline classifies 36 million multi-operator radio measurements collected on Great Britain mainline railways across 2G, 4G and 5G as coverage-limited, interference-limited or acceptable, and reproduces every figure and table in the paper. It also produces per-cell railway deficiency maps covering 15,418 cells of approximately 2 km each.

The raw measurements are not redistributed here. They are published separately by Network Rail on the Rail Data Marketplace and remain subject to its terms.
